title: [Power Display] Preserve profiles across unavailable monitors and capabilities

proposed_comments.title: Block saving unsupported included settings
proposed_comments.body:
### Block saving unsupported included settings

**Severity:** `medium`

When a saved Contrast or Volume value becomes unavailable, `ProfileContrast` and `ProfileVolume` return `null`, but `HasValidSettings` currently does not require either included value to remain present. The editor can therefore report that the profile is valid and save the monitor while silently dropping the requested setting. Require `ProfileContrast` and `ProfileVolume` whenever their corresponding Include flag is set, while still allowing the user to explicitly remove the setting.

confidence.rationale: The current validation expression omits the two optional fields, while the save path explicitly maps unsupported included values to null; the fork regression tests reproduce the resulting CanSave state and pass after adding these guards.

proposed_comments.title: Validate color temperature against advertised presets
proposed_comments.body:
### Validate color temperature against advertised presets

**Severity:** `medium`

`ColorPresetsForDisplay` can include the monitor's current value even when that value is not one of the values advertised by the monitor's VCP 0x14 capability. The new selection validation therefore accepts an unadvertised current value and can preserve or save a color-temperature setting the monitor cannot select. Validate against the underlying advertised preset collection, and keep that check independent from the display collection's synthetic current-value entry.

confidence.rationale: The display collection intentionally adds a synthetic current value; the fork fix adds a MonitorInfo helper over AvailableColorPresets and covers an unadvertised current value with a passing regression test.
